summary: Skratch demonstrates his updated Temporal Vortex setups aiming for over 20 Billion total damage using Dauntless and Toxin teams. He covers Psychicore adjustments, opting for Damage Resistance nodes over raw damage to improve Dauntless survivability. He details key gear setups including Secrecy Order on Maashtur and high Accuracy on Twitch to capitalize on the boss's team-wide damage reduction mechanic.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Equipped with the Secrecy Order set to boost team damage while allies are shielded.

heroes.name: Selva
heroes.note: Helps maintain shields and provides team-wide damage buffs through gear set procs.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Performs best with the Knight Order of Dragon Blood set for HP-to-Attack conversion paired with high Crit Damage.

heroes.name: Jenka
heroes.note: Built with full mythic gear focusing on attack, crit damage, and survival stats.

heroes.name: Kurvida

heroes.name: Twitch

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Requires high Accuracy to prevent debuff resists, as missed debuffs cause huge damage drop-offs.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.note: Provides vital healing and passive damage reduction that keeps the Toxin team alive for the full fight duration.

heroes.name: Stegamoffyn

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Positioned strategic in the front line to maximize team synergy and attack buffs.

teams.note: Dauntless team capable of 9-10B+ damage; requires Damage Resistance Psychicore nodes to survive long fights.
Toxin team reaching 11B+ damage; relies on high Accuracy on Twitch for team damage reduction.

meta_changes: Fey Meander challenge mode unlocks higher tier tempering materials and Mythic gear sets that drastically lift damage caps in Temporal Vortex.
tips: Switch Psychicore nodes to Damage Resistance for Vertigo/Dauntless heroes if they die before the 3-minute mark.
Build your highest Accuracy hero (such as Twitch) as high as possible in Temporal Vortex when Nocturna's handicap is active to grant the entire team free damage reduction.
Prioritize tempering materials on gear slots for fragile teams to stabilize run consistency.
Ensure debuffers like Serpentemis do not miss accuracy checks, as resisted debuffs can cost over 1 Billion in total damage.
